xmldoc.short_description: Change header fields without re-encoding the samples.

param_input_item.param_description: the fields to change: study-level 'Patient', 'Recording', 'StartDate' (dd.mm.yy), 'StartTime' (hh.mm.ss); per-signal 'Labels', 'Units', 'Transducers', 'Prefilters' (each a cellstr, one text per signal, the annotation channel included); or 'Rename', {old, new, ...}.
with 'Output', write the edited file here instead of overwriting file.

description.p: The fixed-width ASCII header is patched and the data block is copied through byte for byte, so nothing is re-quantised. It is how a label, a unit or a patient field is corrected on an existing file without a lossy read and rewrite.
